result:
The proposed answer is incorrect. Computing the limit directly gives β = 1/α, not 1/(1−α).

Sibson's α-mutual information is

I_α(X;Y) = (α/(α−1)) · log ∫ ( Σ_x P(x) p(y|x)^α )^{1/α} dy.

At high SNR the Gaussian densities p(y|x) centered at different support points barely overlap. Near y ≈ √snr·x, the sum is dominated by the single term P(x) p(y|x)^α. Raising this to the power 1/α gives P(x)^{1/α} p(y|x), and integrating over y gives P(x)^{1/α}. Summing over x gives

I_α → (α/(α−1)) · log Σ_x P(x)^{1/α}.

The Rényi entropy of order β is H_β = (1/(1−β)) · log Σ P^β. Setting β = 1/α gives 1/(1−1/α) = α/(α−1), which matches the coefficient above. Hence

I_α(X;Y) → H_{1/α}(X).

The proposed β = 1/(1−α) does not match this derivation.

VERDICT: REJECT
